profile_text.body:
Distributed AI Research Institute is a nonprofit organization founded in 2021 and based in Oakland, California. The institute describes itself as a globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research. It operates as an independent organization focused on technology that benefits everyone, emphasizing that people should see themselves reflected in technology.

The institute conducts research on artificial intelligence with a particular focus on ethical considerations and community impact. According to its website, it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation. The organization believes that while AI tools can be thoughtful, supportive, and inclusive, AI is seldom the solution and its advance should not be treated as inevitable.
